title: How to Freeze Your Credit for Free in Under 10 Minutes
bigPicture: A credit freeze locks your file so thieves cannot open new accounts in your name, and it costs nothing.
whatYouNeedToKnow: It is free by law at Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.
Your own credit cards still work, and your score does not drop.
You get a secret code to unlock it when you need credit.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Freezing only one bureau—thieves can still use the other two.
Forgetting your secret code—write it down and store it safely.
actionSteps: Collect your name, address, birth date, and Social Security number.
Contact Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion online or by phone.
Answer two easy questions and get your secret code.
Write down the codes and test unlocking once.
